newsitem.title: USA: Indiana gov sets special session for state budget.
newsitem.headline: Indiana gov sets special session for state budget.

text.p: Indiana Gov. Frank O'Bannon on Wednesday called for a special legislative session in June to complete work on the state's biennium budget, a spokesman said.
Legislators failed to reach an accord on the budget by midnight Tuesday, the statutory deadline, forcing O'Bannon to call a special session on June 2, Steve Campbell said.
O'Bannon has proposed an approximately $16.8 billion general fund budget for the 1998-99 biennium that would tighten property tax caps and provide income tax credits.
Indiana had a $1.7 billion state surplus at the end of fiscal 1996, which would decrease to just under $1 billion by the end of fiscal 1999 under that proposal.
